The main takeaway from our work is that

the number of days of sick leave and disability pension in the first 5 years after the diagnosis of breast cancer is not significantly higher in patients who receive postoperative radiotherapy than in patients who do not.

it is important to study morbidity over a long time period in breast cancer patients treated with different adjuvant treatment modalities, as the morbidity may not be apparent during the first years after treatment.
